content: अपहारक, -हारिन् {%a.%} One who or that which takes away, steals, removes, destroys, conceals <ab>&c.</ab> (usually in <ab>comp.</ab>); जालापहारिणः <ls>H. 1</ls>; परद्रव्य˚ plunderer, thief; परवित्त˚; वागपहारकः <ls>Ms. 11. 51</ls>; <ls>Y. 3. 210</ls>; <ls>Ms. 4. 255</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">2. 88</ls>. .{@-कः@} A robber, thief.
